attributes.powers:
Before the encounter, each character at this location summons and encounters a random monster.

The first time in this scenario that anyone would defeat the Scribbler, he is undefeated.

"What happened to Thassilon? What became of Runelord Karzoug and Runelord Alaznist?"—The Scribbler
